title.narrative: Power to the Youth: Socially and economically empowered youth, along with CSOs, serve as change agents in five districts to meet developmental and governance challenges arising due to the spread COVID-19.

description.narrative: The action aims to empower low-income youth, socially and economically as change agents in their respective communities. The main objectives are: 1) Local level public entities are engaging youth and providing support to GBV survivors; 2) Youth, especially low income vulnerable ones (women, PWDs, minorities) adversely affected by COVID19 are economically empowered; 3) CSOs and public institutions are actively tackling socio-environmental issues.

description.narrative: The group is comprised of 57 male & female members aged between 1529 years. In each district there are 10 groups. The group engaged and participating in the Action interventions will be accounted for progress against this indicator.

comment.narrative: As indicator is about number of youth group therefore the disaggregation by sex is pertinent for number of members which is given against the indicator related to capacity building rather against this indicator.

The Life of the Action target for this indicator is 50 groups. The groups are formed in Y1 and will continue for remaining year of the action. Therefore the target mentioned against each year denotes the same groups rather new groups. The indicator is to count number of youth group that comprise of male female and transpersons. The group is an entity and could not be segregated by gender by default. However we included the segregation Sex in the indicator and the target in its option Intersex that denotes the number of groups having representation of all sexes.
Group formation was completed in 2021.
